CONTROL AND RESEARCH
CIRCUIT DIRECTORY<New>The floor controls supply
Guidance, Control, and Launch
Safety through the auxiliary
grid.<New>The accelerator banks use a
separate supply. Their
interlock is at Archive
Console D.<New>MAINTENANCE RECORD / 6081
Command-line test
Connection lost for eleven
minutes. Local guidance
remained powered.<New>SAFETY REVIEW
A launch order could remain
in local memory while the
command line was unable to
receive a recall.<New>DIRECTIVE 0320<New>During a strategic alert,
loss of contact does not
cancel a pending launch
order. Proceed unless a
recall has been received.<New>INSTALLATION NOTE
Do not connect the auxiliary
grid to the accelerator
supply. The two circuits must
remain separate.<Close>

AUXILIARY GRID
Manual bypass accepted.<New>Guidance, Control, and Launch
Safety are now receiving
power.
Central Gate auxiliary
supply: ready.<New>Accelerator supply is
controlled separately at
Archive Console D.<Close>

EMERGENCY DIRECTIVE
0320<New>For launch authorization,
enter this number at the
Defense Archive terminal
beyond Central Gate.<Close>
